plugin.name: Neutralize FactionID HUD
plugin.description: Disables the separate FactionID mod's own on-screen faction HUD (its script becomes a no-op) so it doesn't show its own indicator alongside this mod's -- this mod replaces that HUD with its world-anchored tag, so running both means two faction indicators at once. Enabled by default because most setups (GAMMA included) ship FactionID; it is inert if you do not have FactionID installed, and you can uncheck it to keep FactionID's HUD.

plugin.name: Skill System: Perception
plugin.description: Adds a "perception" skill to the Skill System (haru_skills) mod and links it to identification speed: the higher your perception level, the faster you identify targets, and successful identifications grant perception XP. Only install this if you also have the Skill System mod installed.

plugin.name: Wearable Devices Compatibility
plugin.description: Gates identification behind wearable scanner gear from the st-wearable-devices mod. Adds a Promin Antenna module, a 3-tier Promin Process module, and a 3-tier worn Identification Scanner. With the full kit assembled (bracer worn + Promin with antenna and a process module + a worn scanner), identification runs on a tier system: the process tier sets scan speed and gradually unlocks the data shown (faction, distance, relationship, rank, weapon); the scanner tier sets range and unlocks scope/ADS support, a magnification range boost, and no-night-penalty. Tune every tier value on the mod's "Wearable Devices" MCM page. Also plays a faction-specific warning sound when a scan identifies a hostile target (toggleable on the same page). Only install this if you also have st-wearable-devices installed. Uses placeholder item art/models.

plugin.name: HD Faction Patches
plugin.description: Uses the detailed patch artwork from Leekos' HD Faction Patches 2.4 for Immersive Identification's faction emblems. This component includes its own 1024x512 atlas under a unique filename, so the original HD Faction Patches mod is not required and no existing faction atlas is overwritten. Covers Loners, Bandits, Clear Sky, Duty, Freedom, Mercenaries, Military, Ecologists, Monolith, Sin, Renegades and UNISG; Zombified stalkers reuse the inactive Loner patch. Traders, mutants and Arena have no source tile and show no patch. You must also switch on "Custom faction patches" on the mod's UI Style / General MCM page.

plugin.name: GRIP Patches
plugin.description: Uses Kos' GRIP (GAMMA Remastered Icon Pack) faction patch artwork for the tag's faction emblem instead of the game's own faction icons. GRIP: https://discord.com/channels/912320241713958912/1530072690155585688/1530072690155585688 -- its atlas is 1024x512 with 128x128 tiles. This component only registers the mod's ii_patch_* ids as regions of that atlas; no texture is copied, only referenced, so it needs GRIP installed and does nothing without it. PICK ONLY ONE patch component: G.A.M.M.A. UI ships a DIFFERENT atlas under the same file name and the same texture ids (512x256, 64x64 tiles), so choosing the wrong one renders every patch cropped to a corner. You must also switch on "Custom faction patches" on the mod's UI Style / General MCM page; the component alone changes nothing. Covers every faction in the atlas (zombified stalkers reuse its greyed stalker patch); trader, monster and arena have no tile there and show no patch.

plugin.name: GAMMA Patches
plugin.description: Uses the G.A.M.M.A. UI faction patch artwork for the tag's faction emblem instead of the game's own faction icons. Its atlas is 512x256 with 64x64 tiles. This component only registers the mod's ii_patch_* ids as regions of that atlas; no texture is copied, only referenced, so it needs the G.A.M.M.A. UI mod installed and does nothing without it. PICK ONLY ONE patch component: Kos' GRIP ships a DIFFERENT atlas under the same file name and the same texture ids (1024x512, 128x128 tiles), so choosing the wrong one renders every patch cropped to a corner. If both mods are installed, pick the one your load order lets win. You must also switch on "Custom faction patches" on the mod's UI Style / General MCM page; the component alone changes nothing. Covers every faction in the atlas (zombified stalkers reuse its greyed stalker patch); trader, monster and arena have no tile there and show no patch.
